mentions.name: Freebird AI
mentions.description: This VS Code extension provides AI coding assistance as an alternative to GitHub Copilot, available on the VS Code Marketplace. It was built after the author was locked out of Copilot due to exhausted AI credits and had to wait for a credit reset.
mentions.problem: The author was locked out of GitHub Copilot after exhausting their AI credits and had to wait until 1 July for a reset, so they built an alternative AI coding assistant.
mentions.source_excerpt: So i built an alternative, not as great as copilot but it gets the job done. You can check it on the VS Code Marketplace- Freebird AI
